biomesunseen.boss.heart_of_the_forest.ph: The trunk splits open. Branch arms sweep the arena and the floor begins to move.
Roots erupt from the arena floor in telegraphed lines, immobilising anything standing on them.
The canopy loads. Explosive seeds arc across the arena and detonate into a lingering sap field.
The bark plates peel back and the heart-sap core is bare. Damage taken is doubled; so is everything it does.
biomesunseen.boss.void_serpent.phase.1.d: The serpent circles the arena floor, striking with its head and lashing with three body rings.
biomesunseen.boss.void_serpent.phase.2.d: It steps out of existence for four seconds at a time and re-enters somewhere else. Attacks pass through it while out.
biomesunseen.boss.void_serpent.phase.3.d: It coils around the arena centre and slams down, sending a shockwave that must be jumped.
biomesunseen.boss.void_serpent.phase.4.d: Phase length collapses to under a second and the arena starts losing floor. Kill it or fall.
biomesunseen.boss.warden_of_the_hollow_d: It stays under the arena. Only the drill limbs break surface, and tremors telegraph where.
It surfaces and slams. The shockwave travels along the floor and must be jumped; standing on a spire is safe.
Bioluminescent spires rise across the arena, creating high ground and line-of-sight cover. It climbs them.
The carapace cracks open along the seams and vents light. Armour drops to zero; damage output doubles.
biomesunseen.boss.the_skyward_crown.phas: It does not leave the throne platform. Wing gusts push you toward the arena edge and sentinels walk in.
It takes to the air and dive-bombs the arena floor on a telegraphed shadow marker.
The crown detaches and splits into three orbiting shards. The main body is invulnerable until all three are destroyed.
The shards return and fuse. Every ability fires at once and the arena islands begin to drift apart.
biomesunseen.boss.the_unraveling.phase.1: It resolves as a four-legged thing and runs. Fast, low, and it does not stop for walls.
biomesunseen.boss.the_unraveling.phase.2: It elongates into a segmented coil that constricts the arena centre and spits corruption.
biomesunseen.boss.the_unraveling.phase.3: It stands up. It is now the fastest and hardest-hitting form and it summons shards of itself.
biomesunseen.boss.the_unraveling.phase.4: All three forms at once, cycling every six seconds. The arena stops rendering at the edges.
biomesunseen.gear.lumenshade.lore: Light and shadow in one seam. The tools settle the argument in favour of neither.
biomesunseen.gear.voidstone.lore: The blade is serrated because a clean edge would let the cut heal.
biomesunseen.gear.aetherium.lore: Almost weightless. Swings faster than the arm that swings it.
biomesunseen.gear.chronos.lore: The focus ring is not attached to the haft. It has never been attached.
biomesunseen.gear.pyroclast.lore: Heavy, hot, and it keeps whatever it cuts on fire for a while.
biomesunseen.gear.hollowite.lore: Ancient flared bowl head. Chipped by something older than the chipping.
biomesunseen.gear.rootiron.lore: Iron with the grain still in it. Smiths prefer it and will tell you why.
biomesunseen.gear.gloomsteel.lore: Absorbs light. A gloomsteel lantern is a very good way to hide.
biomesunseen.gear.nullite.lore: Deletes what it touches, slowly, in one direction. Aim carefully.
biomesunseen.gear.starforged.lore: Forged from something that fell. It is still slightly warm from the fall.
biomesunseen.armor.lumenshade.lore: Wearer emits a low light. Useful, and impossible to hide with.
biomesunseen.armor.voidstone.lore: The crown points backward. It is not a mistake and it is not decoration.
biomesunseen.armor.aetherium.lore: So light the wearer has to remember they are wearing it.
biomesunseen.armor.chronos.lore: Wearing it makes you slightly early. Slightly. Do not rely on it.
biomesunseen.armor.pyroclast.lore: Fireproof, and it makes the surrounding air share the opinion.
biomesunseen.armor.hollowite.lore: Made for total darkness. Every seam is lit so the wearer can be found.
biomesunseen.armor.rootiron.lore: Cheap, tough, and every village smith can repair it. That is the point.
biomesunseen.armor.gloomsteel.lore: Wearer is difficult to see. Also difficult for their own team to see.
biomesunseen.armor.nullite.lore: Best armour in the mod. It is also slowly deleting the wearer. Trade-off.
biomesunseen.armor.starforged.lore: Still warm. Still falling, in a sense nobody has managed to define.
biomesunseen.armor.set_requirement: Full set of four pieces required.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.luminescent_grov: A grove that never learned the difference between dusk and dawn.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.moonpetal_meadow: The petals only open when nothing is watching them.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.duskwood_hollow: Every tree here grew around something it refused to let go of.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.starfall_glade: The craters are warm. Something is still falling.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.whispering_mire: It repeats the last thing you said, in your own voice, a half-second late.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.aurora_steppe: The light moves like grass. The grass moves like light.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.dreaming_atoll: The tide comes in twice a day and forgets something each time.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.glimmering_thick: Dense enough that the light has to ask permission.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.silken_canopy: The floor of this forest is a rumour. Nobody has confirmed it.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.crystalline_tund: The ice here grew rather than froze. You can see where it branched.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.petal_drift_flat: Flat for a hundred miles and never once still.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.hollowlight_basi: The light pools here the way water pools. It does not drain.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.veilwood: You can see the far treeline. You never get any closer to it.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.lumenshade_glade: The Heart sleeps under this clearing. It dreams in root and sap.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.ghostlight_marsh: The lights lead somewhere. They have never once led anywhere good.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.aetherveil_reach: The ground thins out here. Above it, something is falling upward.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.petrified_forest: A forest that stopped being alive a long time ago and never got the message.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.colossal_boneyar: Ribcages the size of cathedrals. Something ate whatever built them.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.sunken_temple_re: The altar is still above the waterline. That is the only reason it still works.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.ruined_observato: The lens cracked, but it is still pointed at something.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.megalith_moor: Thirty stones. Thirty-one shadows. It is fine. It is always fine.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.forged_waste: An armoury that outlived the war, the kingdom, and the reason.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.ancestor_grove: Every tree was planted by someone who is buried under it.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.titan_graveyard: The vertebrae are used as shelters now. Nobody comments on the scale.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.old_king_road: Still paved. Still patrolled. The patrol has been dead for four hundred years.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.petrified_coloss: They were walking when it happened. They are still walking, slowly.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.hieroglyph_canyo: The carvings are a warning. The warning is repeated, increasingly urgently.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.bronze_steppe: Grass to the horizon and bronze under every spadeful of it.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.shattered_archiv: Every book in the realm, buried in one bad afternoon.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.rootdeep_hollow: The roots came first. The forest is just what they grew to hold.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.ashen_necropolis: It is not haunted. Haunting implies somebody is still trying.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.monolith_shore: Standing stones at the tideline, arranged to be read from the sea.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.primal_savanna: Grass the colour of old brass and predators in all of it.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.bloomfield: Flowers that out-compete the grass and then each other.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.coral_shallows: Water clear enough to read the reef like a page.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.amberwood: Sap runs gold here and the whole forest smells of it.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.sunscorch_badlan: The heat makes the horizon lie to you. It is extremely good at it.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.orchid_lagoon: Every colour the game knows, arguing in one shallow bay.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.verdantheight: Terraced jungle so steep the rain arrives sideways.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.marigold_march: A borderland that grew flowers over the argument.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.pyroclast_fields: Cracked basalt, and something under every crack that is still hot.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.tideglass_bay: The sand has fused to glass in sheets. The tide polishes it daily.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.glimmerleaf_wood: Leaves that hold light for an hour after sunset.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.sakura_highlands: Pink for six weeks a year and unforgettable for the other forty-six.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.sunspore_barrens: Spore-drifts deep enough to lose a boot in, and the boot.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.emberfall_ridge: Autumn that caught fire and has been burning ever since.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.jewel_reef: So much colour the fish have started matching it on purpose.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.harvest_hollows: Terraced, planted, and abandoned mid-harvest. The crop is still coming in.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.volcanic_wastela: The sky is the ground here. Both of them are on fire.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.frozen_expanse: Flat, white, and completely without places to hide.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.scorched_glassla: Sand fused to a mirror by something that passed overhead once.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.blighted_marches: The plants are not dead. That would be simpler.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.howling_peaks: The wind has cut the rock into shapes that sound like voices.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.saltflat_mirage: Water on the horizon for eleven days. There is no water.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.grave_ice_field: Ships, intact, held upright, going nowhere, permanently.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.sulphur_vents: The ground breathes out and everything within a hundred blocks knows it.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.witherwood: Standing deadwood, black, and every branch points at you.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.ironstone_ravine: Cut straight down for two hundred blocks by water that has since given up.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.cinder_dunes: Ash drifted into dunes that move like sand and burn like coals.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.glacier_maw: A cave mouth that exhales. It is warm air. It should not be warm air.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.stormback_steppe: The storm arrives every afternoon and leaves by dark. It has a schedule.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.obsidian_shelf: New land, still black, still sharp, still cooling.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.ashen_caldera: The crater of something that erupted once and has been waiting since.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.rimeforest: Every needle coated in ice, and the forest is somehow still growing.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.abyssal_trench: Deeper than the map is willing to admit.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.kelp_cathedral: Kelp forty blocks tall, in rows, like columns. It was not planted.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.tidal_flats: Twice a day the sea gives it back, and twice a day it is a different shape.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.river_of_lights: The water glows at night and nobody has ever found out why.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.flooded_ruins: A city that lost an argument with the sea and is losing slowly.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.coral_atoll_ring: A perfect ring of reef around a perfect circle of nothing.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.brine_marsh: Too salty to drink, too shallow to sail, too deep to walk.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.glacial_lake: Clear to the bottom, and the bottom is a very long way down.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.mangrove_labyrin: Roots in every direction and no two of them the same shape.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.sunken_cathedral: Vaulting still intact, bell still hanging, service still technically running.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.whitewater_gorge: The river arrives at the gorge at speed and does not slow down for anything.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.pearl_beds: Nacre on the seabed in drifts, and something has been harvesting it.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.blackwater_bog: The water is the colour of strong tea and about as transparent.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.seagrass_meadow: Underwater pasture, and something has been grazing it.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.geyser_lagoon: Warm water, cold air, and a geyser on a fourteen-minute cycle.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.leviathan_gravey: Bones the size of hulls. Several of them are hulls.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.hollow_threshold: Where the tunnel stops pretending to be natural.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.glowcap_grotto: Caps the size of roofs, and every one of them breathing.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.luminous_sea: A lake that lights itself so the things in it can see each other.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.crystal_vault: Geodes the size of houses, split open by something methodical.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.mycelial_wastes: One organism, eleven square miles, no obvious opinion about you.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.gloomslate_depth: Slate that drinks the torchlight and does not give it back.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.root_cathedral: The roots of the surface forest, arriving here as pillars.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.sunken_hollow_ci: They built it underground and it flooded anyway.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.spore_chalk_flat: White chalk, green dust, and footprints that were not yours.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.basaltic_fissure: The only warm place down here, and it is not warm for pleasant reasons.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.weeping_gallerie: Water down every wall, and something has arranged it in lines.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.fungal_forest: Trees, but fungal, and forty blocks tall, and aware.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.echo_chasm: Say something. Wait four seconds. It is not your voice that answers.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.pearl_depths: Nacre on the ceiling, dripping up. Nobody has explained this.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.tremor_ward: Everything here is braced. Everything here is braced against the floor.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.hollow_oasis: Warm water, green light, and the only safe camp for three hundred blocks.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.chitin_warrens: Tunnels lined with shell, all the same diameter, all the same height.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.lantern_terraces: Stepped terraces, and a light on every one of them, still lit.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.deep_bloom_reach: Flowers that evolved in total darkness and glow instead.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.hollow_core: The bottom. It is warmer than the middle. It is not supposed to be warmer.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.dawn_landing: The first island you land on, and the last one you trust.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.cloud_sea: Not water. It behaves like water. Do not test the difference.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.gilded_citadel: Still staffed. The staff are not people any more.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.twilight_terrace: Stepped terraces where the light arrives at an angle it should not.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.dawn_marble_quar: Cut blocks, stacked, counted, and abandoned mid-invoice.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.floating_meadow: Grass, flowers, and forty blocks of nothing underneath.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.stormcell_spire: The lightning here strikes upward on a four-second cycle.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.starfall_vault: Something fell here and was immediately built over.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.aurora_bridge: A span of solid light between two islands that no longer exist.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.celestial_orchar: Fruit that ripens whether or not anybody is going to pick it.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.runeglass_fields: Glass panes with writing on them, planted like crops.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.skyward_steps: A staircase going up for six hundred blocks with no top.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.featherfall_grov: The leaves fall slowly here. Everything falls slowly here.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.shatterbelt: Island gravel in a slow orbit. Mind the gaps. All of them.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.hymn_halls: A hall tuned so that walking through it produces a chord.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.zephyr_reach: Wind that has been blowing in one direction for a very long time.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.gilded_archive: Every expedition that ever came up here, catalogued.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.sunspire_plateau: The highest flat ground in the dimension and the light never leaves it.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.moonpetal_skyfie: Petals drifting between islands, connecting them like a sentence.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.crown_apex: The top of the staircase. There is a throne. It is occupied.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.void_threshold: The last place in this dimension that behaves.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.fracture_plains: Flat, cracked, and the cracks are in the wrong directions.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.static_wastes: The air has grain. You can see through it badly.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.glitch_garden: Flowers rendered in three colours that are not the flower.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.null_sea: Liquid that is not wet. Do not use this to test anything.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.unraveling_nexus: The centre of the error. It has a shape, and the shape keeps changing its mind.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.chrono_shelf: Events here happen in the order they are remembered.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.dusk_mirror: Reflections arrive a half-second after the thing they reflect.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.shardfall_expans: It is raining geometry. Take cover behind something that exists.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.paradox_hollow: A room that is bigger from outside. Both measurements are correct.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.bleeding_spires: Spires that weep something dark and warm and definitely not water.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.wither_veil: Everything here is already dead and has not stopped moving.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.recursive_fields: The same field, seven times, at seven slightly different scales.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.abyssal_shelf_vo: The edge of the dimension, and then a long way down.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.memory_vault: Shelves of things that happened. Some of them are still on loan.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.chromatic_reef: A reef growing in nothing, in colours that have no names yet.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.serpent_run: A corridor three hundred blocks long with scratch marks along all of it.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.hollow_echo: The Hollow Deep, remembered imperfectly, at a distance.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.terminal_glade: The calmest place in the error. That is what makes it frightening.
biomesunseen.lore.biome.outer_margin: Where the dimension stops rendering and keeps going anyway.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.heart_of_the: A clearing with a stump in the middle and root-shapes radiating out of it.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.caldera_aren: A second Overworld arena, built for the Pyroclast fight line.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.warden_of_th: Everything in the room is braced. Everything is braced against the floor.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.the_skyward_: The top of a six-hundred-block staircase, and a throne, and something on it.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.the_unraveli: The centre of the error. It has a shape and the shape keeps changing its mind.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.void_serpent: A corridor three hundred blocks long with scratch marks along all of it.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.hollow_deep_: A doorframe in the rock, already open, already lit.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.aetherfall_p: An arch floating with no island under it. Climb it anyway.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.void_portal: A rectangle of wrongness cut into the deepslate. Do not look at it side-on.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.sunken_templ: The altar is above the waterline. That is the only reason it works.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.petrified_co: They were walking when it happened. They are still walking, slowly.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.sky_citadel: Still staffed. The staff are not people any more.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.root_cathedr: The roots of the surface forest, arriving here as pillars.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.sunken_hollo: They built it underground and it flooded anyway.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.hollow_hut: Somebody lived here. The door is unlocked.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.starfall_cra: The craters are warm. Something is still falling.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.atoll_ruin: The tide comes in twice a day and forgets something each time.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.canopy_walk: Rope, planks, and a great deal of confidence.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.crystal_spir: The ice grew rather than froze. You can see where it branched.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.ruined_obser: The lens cracked, but it is still pointed at something.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.necropolis_g: It is not haunted. Haunting implies somebody is still trying.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.crypt: Sealed from the outside, which is the wrong way round.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.savanna_baob: Built into a tree the size of a keep.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.bloomfield_f: Working farm. Nobody has seen the farmer.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.waystation: A roof, a fire pit, and a signpost to places that no longer exist.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.hollow_oasis: The only safe camp for three hundred blocks.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.crystal_vaul: Geodes the size of houses, split open by something methodical.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.memory_vault: Shelves of things that happened. Some of them are still on loan.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.hymn_hall: A hall tuned so that walking through it produces a chord.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.runeglass_he: Glass panes with writing on them, planted like crops.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.leviathan_ri: Bones the size of hulls. Several of them are hulls.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.abyssal_vent: The water here is warm. Nothing that lives in it should be.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.amberwood_ho: A tree fell over a long time ago and something moved in.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.ancestor_shr: Names are cut into it. Some of the names are still in use.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.aurora_bridg: It only looks solid while you are not looking at your feet.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.barrens_obel: One stone, standing, for no reason anyone has agreed on.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.blackwater_s: Somebody lived here. The door was locked from the inside.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.bleeding_spi: They grow toward the sound of water and away from light.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.blight_pit: The edge is soft. Do not test how soft.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.bone_colossu: A ribcage you can walk into, and something has already walked in.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.brine_hut: Salt-cured timber, salt-cured rope, salt-cured occupant.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.bronze_barro: Green with age and still, somehow, warm to the touch.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.chitin_warre: Every tunnel is exactly wide enough. That is the problem.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.chromatic_re: The colour shifts as you swim through. So do you.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.chrono_ruin: Ruined, but the ruin happened later than the building.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.cinder_oasis: Water in a place that should have boiled it off centuries ago.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.coral_arch: Grown, not built. The symmetry is the unsettling part.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.dusk_mirror_: Every surface reflects. Not all of them reflect the room.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.echo_chasm_s: Drop a stone and you will hear it land twice.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.emberfall_wa: Still lit. Nobody has climbed it in a hundred years.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.fallen_forge: The forge is cold and the last casting was never finished.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.fissure_brid: Planks over a crack that is still widening.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.flooded_temp: The altar is under two metres of clear, still water.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.frozen_wayst: Provisioned for a party that never arrived.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.fungal_fores: A cap the size of a roof, and it is load-bearing.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.geyser_ring: Stones arranged in a circle that always stays dry.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.gilded_archi: Catalogued, indexed, and every entry has been redacted.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.glacial_pier: Built out over ice that has since moved forty metres.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.glacier_cave: Breathes. Cold in, warmer out, roughly every minute.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.glassland_sp: Translucent from the base up, and you can see the stairs.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.glitch_garde: The hedges repeat. The repeats do not match.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.gorge_bridge: Rope, timber, and a drop nobody has ever measured.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.grave_ice_sh: Frozen upright. The manifest is legible.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.harvest_barn: Full. Whatever was stored here was never collected.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.hieroglyph_w: A mile of carving that stops mid-sentence.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.hollow_core_: The door is on the inside of the vault.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.hollow_harbo: Mooring posts for boats that could not have floated here.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.jewel_reef_a: Worth a fortune and structurally load-bearing.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.kelp_cathedr: Nave, aisle, altar. All kelp. All still growing.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.lagoon_platf: Stilts over water clear enough to see the bottom move.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.lantern_terr: Every lantern is lit and none of them have fuel.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.mangrove_pla: Built into the roots rather than on top of them.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.marble_quarr: Abandoned mid-cut, with the tools still racked.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.march_watcht: Sighted along a road that no longer exists.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.meadow_windm: Turns on days with no wind at all.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.monolith_row: Seven stones, evenly spaced, aligned to nothing overhead.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.null_sea_wre: A hull with no water inside it, below the surface.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.obsidian_she: Glass-black, and it hums when struck.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.orchard_pavi: Shade for a harvest that has not been gathered.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.paradox_cham: The room is bigger from the inside by exactly one room.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.peak_aerie: Nest material, arranged. Something is still maintaining it.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.pearl_bed_pa: An oyster farm with the oysters left in place.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.pearl_depth_: Offerings weighted to sink, and they have.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.pyroclast_ve: A chimney that vents straight through the crust.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.ravine_bridg: Older than the ravine, which is the only explanation.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.recursive_fa: Furrowed in a pattern that contains the same pattern.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.rimeforest_s: Ice grown into a shape the trees were persuaded toward.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.river_lanter: Lanterns set to guide boats up a river with no boats.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.rootdeep_cha: Roots form the walls, the ceiling, and the furniture.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.sakura_torii: Painted, repainted, and the paint is still wet.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.saltflat_car: Wagons in a line, wheels sunk, cargo intact.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.seagrass_buo: Buoys marking a channel that has silted shut.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.shatterbelt_: Stepping stones that are not quite where they look.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.shattered_ar: Every scroll is in fragments and every fragment is filed.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.skyward_stai: A staircase with no building attached to it.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.starfall_vau: Lined with something that fell, and it is still warm.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.stormback_li: Glass where the sand was. It branches.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.stormcell_sp: A rod, deliberately, on the highest thing for miles.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.sulphur_vent: Yellow crust, bad smell, worse footing.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.sunken_cathe: Bell tower still above the waterline at low tide.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.sunscorch_ou: Shaded on every side and still unbearably hot.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.sunspire_obe: Catches the first light and holds it too long.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.terminal_gla: The last green thing, kept that way on purpose.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.tidal_weir: Works. Somebody is still maintaining the sluice.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.tideglass_pa: Floor panes over the reef, and the reef is watching.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.titan_remain: A hand, a shoulder, and a great deal of distance between.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.twilight_ter: Terraced for a sun that sets and stays set.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.verdantheigh: Overgrown so thoroughly the walls are optional.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.volcanic_ven: Hundreds of vents, all quiet at the same time.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.witherwood_g: A frame in dead wood. Nothing is hanging from it.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.woodland_cai: Stacked stones, each one carried a long way.
biomesunseen.lore.structure.zephyr_pylon: Anchored against a wind that only blows upward.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.glimmerwing: A moth the size of a hand that carries its own lamp.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.mossback_hare: Grows moss on its back to match whatever it is hiding in.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.petaldancer: Dances. The petals fall where it steps. This is not a metaphor.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.duskstalker: Only visible in the corner of your eye. It knows this and uses it.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.sporeling: A mushroom that decided to walk. It has not decided where.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.mire_wisp: Leads travellers somewhere. It is not trying to help or to harm.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.bogcrawler: Half crab, half something worse, entirely at home in the mud.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.aurora_stag: Its antlers show the aurora. On clear nights this is a disadvantage.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.thicket_sprite: Will trade. Wants seeds. Is extremely firm about the exchange rate.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.silkweaver: Weaves between branches. You notice the web after you are in it.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.canopy_glider: A membrane between wrist and ankle and a great deal of confidence.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.frostling: Made of the cold, and offended by anything warmer.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.glacier_ox: Pulls sledges through drifts that would bury a horse.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.stonehide_boar: Hide that has gone the way of the forest it lives in.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.fossil_wraith: The skeleton is still articulated. That is the worrying part.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.marrow_hound: Hunts in packs and coordinates. The coordination is the problem.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.temple_guardian: Still guarding. Still on duty. Still furious about the flooding.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.astral_scribe: Writing something down. Has been for centuries. Is nearly finished.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.moor_sentinel: One of the standing stones. There were thirty. Count them again.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.slag_golem: A forge that never got shut down properly.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.magma_lurker: Lives in the lava, hunts on the bank, prefers you to come to it.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.canyon_skulk: Colour-matched to the rock. It stays very still and is very patient.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.sunscorch_vulture: Circles. It is very good at circles and very patient about them.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.blighthound: Mange is the wrong word. Nothing is growing back.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.rotstalker: Stands in the treeline and does not need to breathe.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.reefglider: Flies through water the way other fish swim.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.coralback_crab: Wears a reef. The reef is doing well.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.shorelurker: Waits in the shallows for something to wade out.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.river_lamprey: Travels upstream in a straight line regardless of obstacles.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.kelp_serpent: Indistinguishable from the kelp until the kelp moves.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.trench_angler: The light is bait. You already knew that.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.abyssal_leviathan: Rare. Enormous. Not a boss, technically, but you will not survive the distinction.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.highland_goat: Climbs things. Headbutts things. The two are often the same thing.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.gale_harrier: Hunts in the updraft and barely has to flap.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.steppe_rider: Fast, sure-footed, and willing to be ridden if you ask properly.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.savanna_strider: Long legs for long grass and a permanent squint.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.primal_cat: Can be tamed. Should be tamed carefully and with food at the ready.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.orchid_mantis: A flower that catches flies. Then a flower that catches you.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.amber_sentinel: Set to guard the amberwood and has taken the assignment literally.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.veilmourner: Grieving somebody. It has been a long time and it has not improved.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.roadwarden: Still walking the route. Still collecting the toll. Receipts available.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.rootburrower: Comes up through the root mat. The root mat does not warn you.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.grove_warden: Tends the grove. Will defend it. Prefers not to.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.lanternkeeper: Lights the lanterns. Every night. Has never missed one.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.rime_stag: Ice grows along its antlers and sheds every spring.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.meadow_skipper: Enormous, brightly coloured, and completely harmless.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.frozen_mariner: Still in uniform. Still aboard. The ship is ice now.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.luminous_jelly: Drifts, glows, and has no opinion about anything.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.hollow_scout: Maps the tunnels. Sells the maps. Both are honest work.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.glowcap_grub: Fat, glowing, slow. The Hollow Deep considers it a delicacy.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.gloomstalker: You see it in the gloomslate. Then the gloomslate is where you were.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.sporeling_deep: Larger and dimmer than its surface cousins. Down here light is expensive.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.mycelial_horror: One organism. It is having an argument with itself about you.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.fungal_titan: Forty blocks of fungus with a gait and a temper.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.vault_keeper: Keeps the vault. Has no idea what is in it. Keeps it anyway.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.hollow_drowned: The city flooded. They did not leave. They adapted, badly.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.warren_skitter: Harmless alone. Never alone. The warrens are one continuous animal.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.echo_bat: Navigates by echo. Screams constantly. The two facts are related.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.warden_acolyte: Worships the thing under the floor. It has good reason to.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.veilwing: Rides the thermals between islands and rarely flaps.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.cloudfin: Swims in cloud. Nobody has established whether cloud is wet.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.crown_sentinel: Gilded, hollow, and still following orders issued before the fall.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.quarry_construct: Still quarrying. The invoice it is working to was never cancelled.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.rune_construct: A sentence made solid. It reads itself aloud at you.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.stormcell_wisp: A small piece of the storm that got separated and is angry about it.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.orchard_tender: Prunes, waters, harvests. Has done so since before the islands fell.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.astral_scribe_aeth: Recording the fall. It is a very long record.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.unraveling_shard_a: A piece of the Crown that fell and kept orbiting anyway.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.sky_citizen: Lives up here by choice. Considers the surface a rumour.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.void_scout: Came here to map it. The mapping is not going well.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.fracture_hound: Runs in a straight line through walls. The walls lose.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.static_wraith: Grain in the shape of a person. It is very loud up close.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.garden_aberration: A flower rendered wrong, three times over, all of them growing.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.null_swimmer: Swims in something that is not water and does not need to surface.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.chrono_warden: Guards the order of events. You have already disturbed it.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.shardling: Falling geometry that decided to keep going sideways instead.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.spire_climber: Climbs the weeping spires and eats whatever the spires produce.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.mirror_walk: Arrives from the reflection side. The reflection does not come back.
biomesunseen.lore.mob.unraveling_shard: A piece of the Unraveling that came off and kept the habit.
biomesunseen.subtitle.music.heart_of_the: The Heart of the Forest theme
biomesunseen.subtitle.music.warden_of_th: Warden of the Hollow Deep theme
biomesunseen.message.portal.unlit: The frame sleeps. Strike it with an igniter.
